text:
verity: tiny design check-in  pushed a small update to the routing policies editor prototype: compact sticky header (collapses on scroll), reduced chip padding for density, and a preview-disabled state when any rule validation errors exist. need a11y + copy + keyboard flow eyes. figma: https://figma.mock/route-editor-v2

ash: :eyes: nice. main problems I spotted: 1) when tabbing through rules the sticky header sometimes covers the focused item (focus ring hidden). 2) chips look a touch low contrast at 14px.

leo: did a quick contrast run: chip bg #F5F7FA with text #0E1720 = 3.85:1 at 14px. fails WCAG. options: darken text to #07101A (~4.7:1) or nudge bg to #EAEFF6. prefer darkening text to preserve tokens.

tia: small UX/copy thought for the preview-disabled state: current message "Fix rules to preview" is terse and ambiguous. propose: "Preview is unavailable until rule issues are resolved." longer but more explicit, and reads naturally for screen readers. also we should avoid modals for this case  inline banner + disabled toggle feels less interruptive.

verity: agree on copy and darkening text. for the focus clipping I'm debating two approaches: A) auto-scroll focused rule into view offset by header height, or B) collapse header fully on keyboard focus so there's no overlap. thoughts?

ash: option A is safer for motor-impaired users who rely on stable layout. auto-scroll with a small smooth animation is fine. but ensure we don't fight the user's scroll if they manually navigated.

leo: implementation note: make the scroll behavior only trigger on focus events originated from keyboard (tab/shift-tab) or programmatic focus. can detect using :focus-visible polyfill or track last interaction modality. also add aria-live region for validation summary updates.

verity: good call. tia: can you confirm the microcopy key name for i18n?

tia: suggest i18n key: preview.unavailable.rules_unresolved = "Preview is unavailable until rule issues are resolved."

ash: little CSS snippet suggestion for focus scrolling anchor:

```
.rule-item:focus {
  scroll-margin-top: 64px; /* header height when expanded */
  outline: 2px solid #2563EB;
}
```

and when header collapses (keyboard focus) set --header-height: 36px; so scroll-margin-top adapts.

leo: add aria-hidden on the preview region when disabled and set role="status" aria-live="polite" on the validation banner so screen readers announce changes. also include a small visual hint (dim preview pane) for sighted users.

verity: decision recap: 1) chip text -> #07101A at 14px (meets 4.5:1). 2) keep density; use scroll-margin-top approach triggered for keyboard focus to avoid layout jank on pointer scroll. 3) preview toggle disabled when rules invalid; show inline banner copy tia suggested and dim preview (aria-hidden + role=status aria-live=polite). 4) focus ring: 2px solid #2563EB.

ash: can someone open the PR with CSS token changes, focus behavior, aria attributes, and visual snapshots for the overlay/dim state? include an e2e that simulates keyboard nav and checks focused item is visible.

tia: I'll open branch tia/ux/rules-focus-scroll and include i18n key preview.unavailable.rules_unresolved, screenshots, and a short note in the component docs about the header collapse vs scroll decision.

ops-bot: CI: queued visual-regressions for branch tia/ux/rules-focus-scroll  will post results in this thread when ready.

ci-bot: a11y smoke run scheduled for branch tia/ux/rules-focus-scroll (aria-live + aria-hidden checks).

verity: thanks all! small follow-up after PR: let's evaluate the perceived density on a 13" laptop with 125% zoom to ensure we didn't over-compress. :thumbsup:
